channel.title: Venera Khassanova's blog — real estate in Greece and Bulgaria
channel.description: Every day, in plain words: prices, laws, residency and life by the sea in Greece and Bulgaria. The blog of real estate consultant Venera Khassanova.

item.title: How to choose an apartment in Bulgaria: what to look at closely
item.description: Nice photos and a sea view are not everything. My checklist: documents, the building, the floor, the maintenance fee, floor area and the costs of buying a flat in Bulgaria.

item.title: Where to buy in Bulgaria: the coast or the city? Market and rental analysis
item.description: A resort studio or a city flat: which pays off better for living and for renting out? I compare prices, short- and long-term rental yields and the pitfalls.

item.title: Garsoniera, studio, atelier, maisonette: the types of homes in Bulgaria
item.description: Bulgarian listings use words that confuse even locals. In plain words: how a garsoniera, studio, atelier, dvustaen, maisonette and other types of homes differ.

item.title: Work, study and family: the classic routes to Greek residency
item.description: Not everyone moves through investment. How to get Greek residency through work, study or family, and how to become a long-term resident after 5 years.

item.title: Greek Golden Visa without property: deposits, bonds and funds
item.description: You can get a 5-year Greek residence permit without buying a home — through a deposit, government bonds, funds or shares. Here are all the options and amounts.

item.title: Greek residency for financially independent people: pension, rent, dividends
item.description: With passive income of €3,500 a month you can live in Greece without a job and without investing. Who this route suits and how it works.

item.title: Greece digital nomad visa: working remotely by the sea
item.description: Work remotely for a company or clients outside Greece? Then you can live by the sea legally. Conditions, timelines, fees and the tax break.

item.title: Bulgarian residency through property investment: the truth and the conditions
item.description: Buying a flat by the sea does not automatically mean residency. What amount is really required, the strict conditions of this route and who it suits.

item.title: Bulgarian residency for retirees: step by step, without the stress
item.description: A pensioner permit is one of the easiest ways to move to Bulgaria. What pension you need, which documents to gather and how long it takes.

item.title: Bulgaria's digital nomad permit: the new rules since 2025
item.description: Since July 2025 Bulgaria has had a separate residence permit for remote workers. Who it suits, what income you need and what the limits are.

item.title: Bulgarian residency through business, work, study or family
item.description: Four classic routes to Bulgaria: your own company or a representative office, employment, study and family reunification. The conditions of each in plain words.

item.title: How to get residence in Greece in 2026: every option
item.description: The Golden Visa is not the only way into Greece. I walk through all the main residence options: property and investment, passive income, remote work, employment, study and family — with current amounts.

item.title: Ohi Day: how Greece marks 28 October and what it means for life here
item.description: Yesterday Greece celebrated one of its two main national holidays — Ohi Day. Here is what the day commemorates, how the parades work and what to know if you live in Greece or are buying a home here.

item.title: The ECB may raise rates again on 29 October. What it means for mortgages in Bulgaria and Greece
item.description: The ECB has already hiked twice in 2026, and Euribor is up more than a full point. I look at how much more a home loan by the sea will cost — and whether it's worth waiting.

item.title: Can you get rich from renting in Greece? A real Athens deal, broken down
item.description: A flat by the Acropolis bought for €390,000 and rented to tourists — what it really earns, and the pitfalls waiting for anyone who dreams of living off rent.

item.title: Apartments in Greece are 5.5% more expensive than a year ago — and the fastest growth isn't in Athens
item.description: The Bank of Greece has published new home price data. Prices are still rising, but more calmly than in 2025. Here's where they are growing fastest and what it means for buyers.

item.title: A 15% tax for non-EU buyers: what is changing in Greece and why 2027 matters
item.description: Greece plans to raise the tax on buying a home fivefold for citizens of non-EU countries. Here is who it affects, when it starts and what to do if you are looking at a house by the sea.

item.title: Burgas has overtaken Sofia in house price growth. Buy now or wait?
item.description: Housing in Bulgaria got almost 15% more expensive in a year, and Burgas rose fastest of all. Here is what is happening after the switch to the euro, and what it means if you are thinking about a flat by the sea.
